  Terse gloss: "to set up banners, be bannered—displaying military standards in battle array"
  Readable gloss: "This denominative verb derives from degel ('banner, standard') and means to set up or display banners. Psalm 20:5 expresses the hope 'we will set up our banners' in God's name—a military image of rallying and triumph. Song of Songs 6:4 and 6:10 describe the beloved as 'bannered' or 'like bannered hosts'—awesome as an army with banners. The verb conveys military organization, rallying around standards, and the impressive display of ordered forces. Some ancient versions read different verbs here, suggesting textual uncertainty, but the banner imagery fits both contexts well."
